about: Every project that builds on marccent-theme: what it reads from the theme, how it pins it, and its stage. `npm run affected` reads this to say which projects to check after a theme change; `npm run status` reads each project's pin (`pin`: the file, the pattern, a commit, tag or version) from its checkout (`path` in the workspace, or a folder of its repo's name next to the theme) and lists what changed in the theme since, in what the project uses; `npm run todos` reads it for the work lists (docs/todo/<repo>.md). A new project is one more entry. Stages: active (worked on now), frozen (no work until 1.0, PRODUCT-LINE.md 3.5), retired (being removed).

projects.role: WordPress plugin: the WordPress adapter (blocks, runtime, styles)
projects.pins: package.json, marccent-theme by release tag (npm run theme:update; or a commit between releases)

projects.role: WordPress plugin: field groups, post types, Loop, schema
projects.pins: nothing of its own: through Marccent Blocks (Requires Plugins)

projects.role: WordPress block theme: the page frame, patterns
projects.pins: nothing of its own: through Marccent Blocks (Requires Plugins)

projects.role: Django app + django CMS plugins: the Django adapter
projects.pins: marccent.THEME_VERSION, a release tag (scripts/sync_theme.py copies dist/ and markup/reference.json)

projects.role: marccent.com: the Next app, on the theme's React components
plain HTML sites, on the theme's components
